title: Tiny11 Core-Gaming power scheme
description: AtlasOS-style latency-first power scheme. Applied at first boot by gaming-firstboot.ps1. Deliberately NOT the built-in Ultimate Performance scheme - it is a new scheme derived from the High performance template with explicit Atlas-style overrides.
schemeDescription: Latency-first scheme (AtlasOS-style): no CPU idle, no parking, no USB/PCIe power saving.

settings.name: Processor idle disable
settings.note: 1 = no idle. Forces C-State 0 so the CPU never pays a C-State wake penalty. AtlasOS's core latency setting.

settings.name: Minimum processor state
settings.note: Never downclock - avoids clock ramp lag on a frame spike.

settings.name: Processor performance boost mode
settings.note: 2 = Aggressive. Hidden by default; the script unhides it before setting.

settings.name: Processor performance time check interval
settings.note: Shorter interval = faster response to load changes.

settings.name: Processor performance core parking min cores
USB selective suspend
settings.note: 0 = disabled. Keeps mouse / keyboard / controller polling constant.

settings.name: PCI Express ASPM
settings.note: 0 = off. Removes PCIe link power-state transition latency for the GPU.

bcd.note: Required for the VBS/HVCI-off path; also removes Hyper-V scheduler overhead.
Prefer the invariant TSC over the platform clock.
Keep the system timer running at a constant rate.
Keep DEP enabled - this is not a security downgrade.
